title: Flaky Uruguayan Spaghetti
description: A comforting dish featuring spaghetti, crispy parmesan, and a floral touch of cilantro, all in a diabetic-friendly flambe sauce.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil, then cook the spaghetti according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the red pepper flakes and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the flambe sauce and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let cook for 2 minutes, until slightly thickened.
Add the cooked spaghetti to the skillet and toss to coat with the flambe sauce.
Transfer the spaghetti to a serving dish and sprinkle with parmesan cheese and chopped cilantro.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
